plugins.title: binoc-stdlib
plugins.summary: Binoc's built-in rule pack. It handles the baseline formats and structural cases most readers encounter first: directories, archives, compressed streams, CSV/TSV, common text formats, JSON/YAML/TOML/INI, generic binary fallback, move/copy detection, and output renderers.
plugins.distribution: Built into every `binoc` install; no separate package is needed.
plugins.handles: Directory and archive structure, tabular data, text and structured documents, compressed snapshots, binary fallback, move/copy correspondence, and Markdown output.
plugins.produces: Container expansions, tabular and text edits, move/copy and reshape claims, binary fallback diagnostics, and Markdown changelogs.

plugins.title: binoc-avro
plugins.summary: Parses Avro snapshots as structured data so changes in records and fields surface as normal Binoc diffs.
plugins.distribution: Bundled in the default `binoc` 0.2.0 fat wheel.
plugins.produces: Parsed Avro records and field-level changes.

plugins.title: binoc-binformats
plugins.summary: Parses common binary interchange formats into JSON-like values so content changes become visible as structured diffs.
plugins.distribution: Bundled in the default `binoc` 0.2.0 fat wheel.
plugins.handles: CBOR, BSON, Ion, MessagePack, and plist snapshots.
plugins.produces: Parsed structured values and value-level changes.

plugins.title: binoc-dbf
plugins.summary: Parses DBF snapshots so table and row changes in legacy dBase-style datasets show up as structured tabular diffs.
plugins.distribution: Bundled in the default `binoc` 0.2.0 fat wheel.

plugins.title: binoc-excel
plugins.summary: Parses Excel workbooks so sheet, row, column, and cell changes can be compared as Binoc tabular changes.
plugins.distribution: Bundled in the default `binoc` 0.2.0 fat wheel.
plugins.produces: Workbook structure and sheet/table content changes.

plugins.title: binoc-html
plugins.summary: Supports HTML-related parsing and rewriting for datasets that publish or embed structured content in HTML snapshots.
plugins.distribution: First-party Python add-on package discovered through `binoc.plugins` entry points.
plugins.handles: HTML files and HTML-embedded structured data.
plugins.produces: Parsed HTML-derived artifacts and content changes.

plugins.title: binoc-parquet
plugins.summary: Parses Parquet snapshots so column, row, and cell changes appear as ordinary tabular diffs.
plugins.distribution: Bundled in the default `binoc` 0.2.0 fat wheel.

plugins.title: binoc-row-reorder
plugins.summary: Detects row reordering in tabular data so shuffles are represented as ordering changes rather than as noisy row removals and additions.
plugins.distribution: Bundled in the default `binoc` 0.2.0 fat wheel.
plugins.produces: Row-reorder correspondence and compact move-like row changes.

plugins.title: binoc-shapefile
plugins.summary: Handles shapefile bundles and their sidecar files so feature, geometry, and attribute changes stay aligned across the dataset package.
plugins.distribution: Bundled in the default `binoc` 0.2.0 fat wheel.

plugins.title: binoc-sqlite
plugins.summary: Compares SQLite databases: schema, columns, keys, and row counts. Useful when a dataset ships as `.db` / `.sqlite` snapshots instead of flat files.
plugins.distribution: First-party opt-in rule pack. Separate PyPI publishing is paused, and SQLite is intentionally excluded from the default `binoc` 0.2.0 `bundled` feature set; build from source with the `sqlite` cargo feature when this pack is needed.
plugins.produces: Table/column layout changes, type changes, key changes, and row-count diffs.

plugins.title: binoc-stat-binary
plugins.summary: Reads Stata, SAS, and SAS transport files as standard Binoc tabular data so normal column, row, and cell diffing applies.
plugins.distribution: Bundled in the default `binoc` 0.2.0 fat wheel. Separate PyPI publishing is paused.
plugins.handles: Stata `.dta`, SAS `.sas7bdat`, and SAS transport `.xpt` files.
plugins.produces: Tabular records and tabular diffs for statistical binary formats.

plugins.title: binoc-xml
plugins.summary: Parses XML snapshots into structured data so hierarchical document and metadata changes can be tracked as Binoc diffs.
plugins.distribution: Bundled in the default `binoc` 0.2.0 fat wheel.
plugins.handles: XML files and XML-based metadata documents.
plugins.produces: Structured XML artifacts and element/attribute-level changes.
